extensionDescription.message: Cleans your YouTube feed and your links: hides videos you've already watched or that keep reappearing, and strips tracking parameters (si=, feature=) from links you copy or share. Optional filters hide Shorts, Mixes, live streams, premieres, short videos, blocked channels, and title keywords; optional telemetry-beacon blocking (off by default). Private by design: no telemetry of its own, everything stays in local storage.
